Morning access to the grounds does not mean the buildings are open; check trolley operation before counting on a ride.

观察任务：找一种旧交通工具、一块商店招牌和一个与现在不同的生活用品。先让孩子描述: Observation game: find an old means of transport, a shop sign, and an everyday object unlike one used today. Let children describe what they see before reading the interpretation.
